name: OpenOS 1.5.0
description: Scene-based 3D in OSA SDK 5: d3.begin/d3.end/d3.present collect a whole frame into one depth-sorted scene, and d3.present renders it through a small band sprite, so the full 240x320 screen is drawn at 16-bit colour (20-22 fps with five shapes). New shapes: box, sphere, cylinder, cone, torus, plane and custom meshes, plus d3.view orbit and d3.light. Control Center is now a grid of tiles with icons. Compiled bytecode is cached on the SD card, so apps and the home screen start about twice as fast after the first run. Launching an app from Home zooms its tile into the screen. New widgets: ui.icon (27 built-in icons), ui.iconButton and a floating ui.tabbar. The heap reserve gives up only what a sprite needs, so 3D scenes and OPK extraction keep their memory. Try 3D Shapes from OpenStore.
